name: sc036-artifacts-403-withheld
description: 036 T095 (C3.2, FR-018) — the 403-WITHHELD class, and C3.2 is the load-bearing row of the whole contract. The shared transport maps 401/403 to the auth exit code for every caller; propagating it here would fail EVERY reconcile for a team whose token merely lacks the optional Create attachments permission. Both ports must translate at the publication call site: identical exit code, identical warning naming the ticket and the remedy, identical `withheld`/`upload-failed` entries, and the reconcile own earlier writes standing. The fault is keyed on COMP-1 because the fixture creates its specification ticket first and deterministically.
